reset_fee: Phase 1: 60% off the original cost; Phase 2: 130% of the challenge cost to stay in Phase 2, or 50% off to restart from Phase 1; Instant: 50% off. One reset per challenge, claim within 48h of breach.
refund_policy: Full refund within 14 days of purchase only if no trade has been opened. Evaluation fee refunded with the second funded payout (Instant Funding: 200% refund bonus with the second payout).
ea_bots: restricted: risk-management EAs and EAs developed by the trader (incl. AI-assisted, if fully understood) only; off-the-shelf, grid and hedging EAs banned
max_risk_per_trade: 2% of initial balance per trade idea (2-Step funded phase; 1-Step Pro challenge and funded); Instant Funding: floating loss across open trades max 1% of initial balance; Instant max 20 lots per trade
inactivity_rule: At least one trade every 30 days (first period starts at purchase); otherwise account permanently failed
notes: Payout minimums: $50 crypto, $200 Rise; processing 24-48h excluding weekends. KYC required to receive a funded account (homepage FAQ). Copy trading only between your own FundingTraders accounts (copy software between Instant accounts not allowed; copying others' trades banned). Hedging across accounts and hedge EAs are hard breaches. Commission on funded accounts: $3/lot round trip (Instant $6/lot), indices excluded; 'Zero Fees' add-on removes it. Add-ons (checkout only): profit split 90%/100%, 14-day payout, No Minimum Trading Days, Daily Drawdown Shield, Second Phase Reset, Breach Payout Protection (pays up to 2% of size), Double-Up, On-Demand Payout (Instant), Evaluation Profit Share 15%, News Holding (Instant). Also a 'Revive' feature. VWHT must be >= 2 min; repeated trades <= 15s (HFT) banned. No time limit stated on the pages read, so time_limit left null. Strike/tier system can deduct profit at payout (Risk Management article).
